sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PORTIONS OF TX
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE UPPER OH VALLEY...

sections.title: TX
sections.text: OUTLOOK ADJUSTMENTS MADE IN ACCORDANCE WITH CONVECTIVE COMPLEX EXITING THE UPPER TX COAST. PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT INTO THIS EVENING IS STILL EXPECTED ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE RIO GRANDE VALLEY/WEST-CENTRAL TX AND EVENTUALLY PORTIONS OF SOUTH-CENTRAL TX/HILL COUNTRY...AS STORMS/SUPERCELLS CONTINUE TO INCREASE AND PROPAGATE EASTWARD ACROSS THE RIO GRANDE OUT OF MEXICO. SEE SEVERE TSTM WATCH 156 AND ASSOCIATED MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS.

sections.title: UPPER OH VALLEY
sections.text: LITTLE CHANGE TO PRIOR OUTLOOK REASONING...ALTHOUGH SPATIAL ADJUSTMENTS TO SLIGHT RISK WERE MADE /REMOVED/ IN THE WAKE OF UPPER OH VALLEY QUASI-LINEAR COMPLEX. DAMAGING WINDS/SOME SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE INTO THIS EVENING. ..GUYER.. 05/10/2013 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1129 AM CDT FRI MAY 10 2013/

sections.title: TX
sections.text: BOTH VISIBLE SATL IMAGERY AND SFC ANALYSIS REVEAL A PLETHORA OF CONVECTIVELY INDUCED MESOSCALE BOUNDARIES ACROSS TX TODAY. MEANWHILE...A BAND OF RELATIVELY STRONGER WLY MID LEVEL FLOW OF 40-50KT PERSISTS OVER THE SRN HALF OF TX ON THE SRN/ERN FLANK OF A POSITIVELY TILTED LARGE SCALE TROUGH WITH AN AXIS FROM THE CNTRL PLAINS TO NRN BAJA. PERTURBATIONS WITHIN THIS MID/UPPER LEVEL STREAM WILL AGAIN COMBINE WITH AREAS OF STRONGER DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION TO SUPPORT SCATTERED STRONG TO SEVERE TSTMS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AND INTO THIS EVENING. AFTER A NUMBER OF OUTFLOW SURGES...GREATEST SFC-BASED INSTABILITY NOW RESIDES ACROSS FAR SOUTH TX WHERE STRONG CAPPING WILL LIKELY PERSIST DUE TO PRONOUNCED EML PLUME. FROM TRANS-PECOS REGION ACROSS THE HILL COUNTRY...AREAS OF STRONGER HEATING AND MODEST LARGE SCALE ASCENT WILL CONTRIBUTE TO AN INCREASE IN CONVECTION AMIDST MORE THAN SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER SHEAR FOR UPDRAFT ROTATION/PERSISTENCE. LARGE HAIL SHOULD BE THE GREATEST HAZARD FROM THIS ACTIVITY. HOWEVER...LOW PROBABILITY TORNADO THREAT MAY ALSO EVOLVE WITH ANY DISCRETE CELLS INTERACTING WITH RESIDUAL BOUNDARIES WHERE BACKED LOW LEVEL FLOW WILL ENHANCE HODOGRAPH CURVATURE.

sections.title: UPPER OH VALLEY
sections.text: WARM/MOIST CONVEYOR BELT WILL INTENSIFY FROM THE SPINE OF THE APPALACHIANS WWD ACROSS THE UPPER OH VALLEY AS FRONTAL WAVE/LOW TRACKS EAST ACROSS THE ERN GREAT LAKES THROUGH THIS EVENING. WEAK LAPSE RATES ALOFT WILL RESULT IN ONLY MARGINAL INSTABILITY WITHIN THE WARM SECTOR WITH AFTERNOON SBCAPE PERHAPS PEAKING AROUND 1000 J/KG. THE LIMITED INSTABILITY SHOULD BE SOMEWHAT OFFSET BY MAGNITUDE OF FORCING/ASCENT AND AREAS OF STRONGER SURFACE HEATING FROM NRN WV ACROSS SERN OH AND INTO PA. HERE EXPECT A GRADUAL UPTICK IN CONVECTIVE VIGOR AMIDST SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER SHEAR FOR SOME STORM-SCALE ORGANIZATION/PERSISTENCE. MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONGER WIND GUSTS APPEAR POSSIBLE WITH LOOSELY ORGANIZED LINES/CLUSTERS OF STORMS MOVING ACROSS THE REGION THROUGH EARLY EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO WILL PERSIST NEXT 2-3 HOURS AS STORMS MOVE THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF SERN LA INTO THE MS BOOTHEEL. NRN END OF LINE IS EXPECTED TO WEAKEN AS IT CONTINUES INTO SWRN AL. THOUGH A LIMITED SEVERE THREAT WILL EXIST DOWNSTREAM FROM WW 154...OVERALL THREAT IS NOT EXPECTED TO BECOME SUFFICIENT FOR ANOTHER WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ORGANIZED LINE OF STORMS IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST NEXT COUPLE HOURS THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF SERN LA INTO THE BOOTHEEL OF MS. STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO FORWARD PROPAGATE INTO A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER OVER SERN LA WHERE THE 12Z SLIDELL RAOB INDICATES 70F DEWPOINTS...50+ KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR AND MODEST INSTABILITY SUPPORTIVE OF EMBEDDED MESO-VORTICES AND BOWING SEGMENTS. THE NRN END OF THE LINE IS APPROACHING THE ERN BOUNDARY OF WW 154 AS IT MOVES THROUGH SERN MS. HOWEVER...A SUBSTANTIAL DECREASE IN NEAR SFC DEWPOINTS AND INSTABILITY IS EVIDENT WITH ERN EXTENT INTO SWRN AL...AND THIS SHOULD SUPPORT A WEAKENING TREND AS STORMS CROSS INTO AL. ..DIAL.. 05/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLD LARGE HAIL POTENTIAL MAY AFFECT THE MIDDLE AND UPPER TX COASTAL PLAIN. A SEVERE WATCH DECISION WILL LIKELY NEED TO BE MADE BY 14Z OR SO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS A DIFFUSE CLUSTER OF EWD MOVING STORMS FROM 20 MI E SAT TO 20 MI WSW UTS. AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDS FROM THE TRAILING EDGE OF THE LA MCS WWD TOWARDS THE STORM OVER WILSON COUNTY. THE STORMS ALONG AND N OF THE BOUNDARY ARE LIKELY ROOTED AT THE TOP OF THE BOUNDARY-LAYER ON THE NERN PERIPHERY OF AN UNCONVECTIVELY-MODIFIED EML PLUME OF VERY STEEP LAPSE RATES SAMPLED BY THE 12Z CRP RAOB. ADEQUATE MID LEVEL FLOW /40 KT AT KEWX AND KHGX AT 6 KM AGL/ WILL ACT TO SUPPORT UPDRAFT ORGANIZATION. AS SUCH...A LARGE HAIL THREAT MAY DEVELOP/INCREASE AS THE STORMS MOVE EWD AND IMPACT THE MIDDLE TO UPPER TX COASTAL PLAIN THROUGH THE MORNING HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL ACCOMPANY ORGANIZING SQUALL LINE AS IT PROGRESSES ACROSS THE OH VALLEY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LONG-LIVED MCS WITH AN EXPANSIVE AREA OF POST SQUALL LINE PRECIPITATION IS SPREADING ACROSS THE OH VALLEY EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. LATEST RADAR DATA SUGGESTS CENTER OF OLD MCV IS SHEARING NEWD ACROSS KY...CURRENTLY LOCATED ABOUT 40 SE OF SDF. STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING ACROSS ERN OH INTO WRN PA HAS CONTRIBUTED TO STEEP SFC-3KM LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT AND THIS APPEARS PARTLY RESPONSIBLE IN RECENT RASH OF ISOLATED CONVECTION AHEAD OF MATURING SQUALL LINE. GIVEN THE MODEST SWLY DEEP LAYER FLOW THERE IS REASON TO BELIEVE SQUALL LINE WILL ADVANCE ACROSS ERN OH/NRN WV AT ROUGHLY 30-35KT REACHING WRN PA LATE THIS AFTERNOON. MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS ARE THE GREATEST SEVERE THREAT WITH THIS ACTIVITY AND MOST CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO PRODUCE GUSTS LESS THAN 40KT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCTD STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON OVER THE MIDDLE RIO GRANDE VALLEY AND POSE A LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND RISK WITH THE MORE ROBUST STORMS. AN ATTENDANT VERY LARGE HAIL THREAT MAY MATERIALIZE WITH THE MORE INTENSE SUPERCELLS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACES A DECELERATING COLD FRONT FROM THE TX BIG BEND EWD THROUGH THE TX HILL COUNTRY WITH AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ARCING WNWWD FROM 30 MI S SAT TO 20 MI S 6R6. THESE BOUNDARIES AND THE HIGHER TERRAIN OVER THE TX BIG BEND AND NRN COAHUILA WILL SERVE AS FOCI FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS AS THE CAP IS EFFECTIVELY REMOVED...AND AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER CONTINUES TO HEAT/DESTABILIZE AHEAD OF A BAJA CA UPPER TROUGH. THE ELY COMPONENT TO THE LOW LEVEL FLOW HAS LED TO LOWER 50S DEWPOINTS MOVING INTO THE AREA SURROUNDING THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND CONTRIBUTED TO A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS /1000-2500 J/KG MLCAPE/. STRONG WSWLY FLOW IN THE MID-HIGH LEVELS IS YIELDING 50-60 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR AND WILL AID IN UPDRAFT ORGANIZATION/PERSISTENCE...INCLUDING SUPERCELLS. THE MAIN THREATS WITH THESE STORMS WILL BE LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS. AN ISOLD VERY LARGE HAIL THREAT /2 INCHES OR GREATER IN DIAMETER/ IS POSSIBLE WITH ANY INTENSE SUPERCELL...ALONG WITH A CONDITIONAL NON-ZERO TORNADO THREAT GIVEN BACKED LOW LEVEL FLOW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE HAIL/LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE WILL REMAIN A POSSIBILITY THROUGH EARLY EVENING ACROSS WESTERN/NORTHERN PORTIONS OF PA AND WESTERN NY...WITH A DOWNWARD INTENSITY TREND EXPECTED THEREAFTER.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AHEAD OF AN EAST-NORTHEASTWARD MOVING QUASI-LINEAR CONVECTIVE COMPLEX MOVING INTO FAR WESTERN PA AS OF 21Z...SCATTERED RELATIVELY LOW-TOPPED STORMS ARE ONGOING AHEAD OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE ACROSS WESTERN PA...WITH OTHER SEMI-DISCRETE STORMS/LOW-TOPPED SUPERCELLS OCCURRING ACROSS WESTERN NY. WEAK BUT SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY /FEW HUNDRED MLCAPE/ EXISTS TO MAINTAIN THESE LOW-TOPPED SUPERCELLS IN THE SHORT-TERM ACROSS WESTERN NY...ESPECIALLY GIVEN A STRENGTHENING DEEP LAYER WIND FIELD AND 30-35 KT LOW LEVEL JET /PER REGIONAL WSR-88D VWP DATA/ VIA AN AMPLIFYING UPSTREAM UPPER TROUGH. WHILE DAMAGING WINDS AND BOUTS OF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL /GENERALLY 1 INCH OR LESS/ WILL REMAIN A CONCERN OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...A TENDENCY FOR CONVECTIVE INFERENCE WILL LIKELY ABATE SUPERCELL POTENTIAL BEYOND THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO...WITH A POST-SUNSET COOLING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER OTHERWISE LEADING TO A DECREASING INTENSITY TREND THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE INCREASING IN COVERAGE ACROSS WEST CENTRAL TX. THE ENVIRONMENT SUPPORTS A CONTINUED RISK OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THROUGH THE EVENING. NEW WATCH MAY BE NEEDED IN THE TPL/ACT AREA IF STORMS CONTINUE TO STRENGTHEN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE INCREASING IN INTENSITY AND COVERAGE OVER PARTS OF WEST CENTRAL TX. ONE AREA OF CONVECTION IS ALONG/NORTH OF A WEAK SURFACE BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM JUST NORTH OF SAT TO NEAR DRT. ANOTHER CLUSTER OF STRONG STORMS IS OVER COLEMAN/BROWN COUNTIES TX. THE NORTHERN CLUSTER WILL BE MOVING OUT OF WW 156 SOON...AND A NEW WATCH FARTHER EAST IS BEING CONSIDERED. OTHERWISE...STORMS ARE LIKELY TO CONTINUE TO GENERATE OVER THE MOUNTAINS OF NORTHERN MEXICO AND DRIFT EASTWARD INTO THE WATCH AREA. AMPLE INSTABILITY/LAPSE RATES AND FAVORABLE EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL PROMOTE SUPERCELL STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THROUGH THE EVENING. ..HART.. 05/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO AFFECT PARTS OF SOUTHEAST AR...NORTHERN MS...AND WEST TN THIS EVENING. A FEW STORMS MAY INTENSIFY TO SEVERE LIMITS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. HOWEVER...THE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED AND A WATCH IS CURRENTLY NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A WEAK SURFACE COLD FRONT EXTENDS FROM THE MO BOOTHEEL SOUTHWESTWARD TO NEAR TXK. SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS AHEAD OF THE FRONT HAVE RESULTED IN AN AXIS OF MID 60S SURFACE DEWPOINTS AND MODERATE INSTABILITY FROM WEST TN INTO MUCH OF LA. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE OCCURRING ALONG/AHEAD OF THE FRONT OVER SOUTHEAST AR. THIS ACTIVITY IS FORECAST BY SEVERAL MODEL SOLUTIONS TO PERSIST AND TRACK EASTWARD ACROSS NORTHERN MS/WEST TN THIS EVENING. THE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT IS SUFFICIENT FOR A RISK OF HAIL AND GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS IN THE STRONGEST STORMS. HOWEVER...EFFECTIVE SHEAR IS ONLY MARGINAL FOR ORGANIZED STORMS /25-30 KNOTS/ AND LOW LEVEL SHEAR IS WEAKENING WITH TIME. ALSO...A LARGE CIRRUS CANOPY FROM MCS TO THE SOUTH WILL OVERSPREAD PARTS OF THE RISK AREA SLIGHTLY DECREASING THE LAST COUPLE HOURS OF HEATING. THE AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...BUT IT APPEARS A WATCH WILL NOT BE REQUIRED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE STORMS SPREADING TOWARD THE SOUTH EDGE OF WW 156.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED INTENSE THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUE TO AFFECT PORTIONS OF SOUTH CENTRAL TX ALONG AND NORTH OF A SURFACE COLD FRONT. THE STRONGEST STORMS ARE CURRENTLY OVER BEXAR/MEDINA/FRIO COUNTIES TX AND ARE TRACKING SOUTHEASTWARD AT 25-35 KNOTS. AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY REMAINS UPSTREAM OF THESE STORMS...SUGGESTING THAT ACTIVITY MAY PERSIST FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS. GIVEN THE CURRENT SPEED...THE STORMS WILL TRACK OUT OF WW 156 AROUND 01Z. A NEW WW WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED FOR PARTS OF SOUTH TX BEFORE THAT TIME. ..HART.. 05/10/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS THAT WERE EARLIER TRACKING SOUTHEASTWARD TOWARD THE VCT/CRP AREA HAVE DIMINISHED. HOWEVER...NEW STORMS HAVE FORMED WEST OF LRD AND MAY AFFECT PORTIONS OF THE WATCH AREA SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A NEW CLUSTER OF INTENSE THUNDERSTORMS HAS FORMED OVER NORTHERN MEXICO JUST WEST OF LRD. THESE STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED IN VICINITY OF A WEAK COLD FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT NOW STRETCHES FROM NORTH OF LRD TO NEAR VCT. THE 00Z CRP RAOB INDICATED A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AND STEEP LAPSE RATES ALOFT...BUT ALSO INDICATED A CAPPING INVERSION THAT WILL LIKELY KEEP STORMS FROM DEVELOPING TOO FAR EAST. NEVERTHELESS...SUPERCELL STORMS MAY CROSS THE RIO GRANDE INTO WEBB/LA SALLE/DUVAL COUNTIES TX DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE. ..HART.. 05/11/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MCS MAY POSE A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL NEXT COUPLE HOURS OVER A PORTION OF DEEP S TX. HOWEVER...TRENDS HAVE BEEN FOR STORMS TO WEAKEN AND BECOME LESS ORGANIZED DURING THE LAST COUPLE HOURS...AND OVERALL THREAT APPEARS INCREASINGLY MARGINAL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MCS IS MOVING THROUGH WRN PORTION OF DEEP S TX AT AROUND 20 KT. BOTH CAPPI AND MESH TRENDS HAVE BEEN DECREASING DURING THE PAST COUPLE HOURS. THE ATMOSPHERE ACROSS DEEP S TX REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH 2000-2500 J/KG MUCAPE. HOWEVER...THE 00Z RAOB FROM BROWNSVILLE SHOWED A PRONOUNCED CAPPING INVERSION ASSOCIATED WITH WARM AIR AT THE BASE OF THE EML. BASED ON RECENT CONVECTIVE TRENDS IT APPEARS CONVECTIVE INHIBITION MAY BE HAVING A DETRIMENTAL EFFECT ON THE STORMS. NEVERTHELESS...SOME POTENTIAL STILL EXISTS FOR A COUPLE OF STORMS TO INTENSIFY WITHIN ZONE OF FORCING AND ASCENT ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...BUT OVERALL CONFIDENCE IN A MORE ROBUST THREAT IS NOT PARTICULARLY HIGH AT THIS TIME. ..DIAL.. 05/11/2013 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MAY POSE A LIMITED THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL OVER SERN COASTAL LA NEXT COUPLE HOURS. THREAT AREA IS TOO SMALL FOR WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS HAVE INCREASED OVER THE NWRN GULF IN ASSOCIATION WITH AN MCV INTERACTING WITH AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY LAID OUT FROM EARLIER STORMS. ACTIVITY HAS ORGANIZED INTO A LINE WITH BOWING SEGMENTS OVER THE NWRN GULF...WHILE MORE DISCRETE ROTATING STORMS EXIST FARTHER EAST ALONG SERN COASTAL LA. THOUGH LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS WEAK...STORMS ARE EMBEDDED WITHIN FAVORABLE WIND PROFILES WITH 50+ KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR FOR ORGANIZATION. THE STRONGER STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO REMAIN OVER COASTAL LA AND OFFSHORE ALONG AND SOUTH OF E-W ORIENTED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WHERE THE NEAR SURFACE LAYER IS VERY MOIST AND MORE UNSTABLE COMPARED TO FARTHER INLAND.
